title: Compact Expo product video gallery
summary: Use a landscape stage for video slides and explicit player dimensions to remove the oversized dark area.

changes.detail: Video slides use a compact 16:9 stage; photos retain their larger stage. Explicit player width and height fill the stage on web. Playback controls, contain fitting and pagination are preserved.
